observation_model.entry: The historical barrier-path sensitivity replay assumes a fill at the immutable planned next-bar-open quote. It does not infer a fill from a limit touch, queue position, or actual execution.
observation_model.lower_interval: Use aligned Binance trade 1m and mark 1m OHLC bars to determine which barrier was reached first across minutes.
observation_model.within_one_minute: If both barriers are inside the same 1m high-low range and the open did not gap through the stop, retain AMBIGUOUS and report a separate stop-first conservative bound.
observation_model.stop_gap: If a 1m open gaps beyond the stop, record the open as a hypothetical adverse gap fill; it is not an observed exchange fill.
observation_model.brackets: TakeProfit documents emulator brackets as position-level OCO orders whose quantity follows the current position. Live attached-order behavior is controlled by the selected exchange and remains unknown.
observation_model.reload: The deterministic model persists candidate IDs, order state, position, bracket state, cooldown state, and event sequence; replaying the same event suffix after restoration must produce identical outputs.

historical_replay.fill_assumption: assumed fill at the immutable planned quote; not an observed fill
historical_replay.boundary_rule: 1m OHLC determines ordering across minutes; if one 1m bar touches both barriers, outcome stays ambiguous and is not reported as observed stop-first.

platform_backtest.interpretation: The bounded platform run emitted no orders or trades and its returned last bar fell outside the requested range. It does not validate order fill/exit transitions; fixture coverage is local and deterministic.

limitations: Historical 1m path replay is conditional on a hypothetical fill at the planned quote and is not a trade or profitability backtest.
OHLC cannot resolve event ordering inside one minute; ambiguous bars retain the ambiguity and expose a stop-first conservative bound.
The TakeProfit emulator bracket model is not a Binance live-exchange execution guarantee.
Fee, queue position, actual partial-fill quantity, slippage, and funding are not inferred from OHLC.
